days.title: Lakeside Estates and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mucross
stops.detail: In the south, the over 100 km² national park borders the town of Killarney; it includes the three lakes Lough Leane as well as Mucross and Upper Lake, which together cover an area of 22 km² in the park.

stops.name: Torc-Wasserfall
stops.detail: From Muckross House, one can explore the surroundings by single-axle horse-drawn carriages or on foot; a popular destination is the Torc Waterfall.

days.title: Castles and Islands of Lough Leane
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lough Leane
stops.detail: On a peninsula in Lough Leane lies the tower house Ross Castle, where one can gain an insight into the everyday life of a clan chief.

stops.name: Ross Castle
stops.detail: On the eastern shore of Lough Leane lies the late medieval Ross Castle, which is partially in ruins.

stops.name: Innisfallen Island
stops.detail: The island of Innisfallen Island can be visited with the remains of the once mighty Innisfallen Abbey.
